title: Affordance-Conditioned Decision Making: Bridging the Semantic-Spatial Gap in Zero-Shot Cross-Floor Vision-and-Language Navigation
abstract: arXiv:2609.32292v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Vision-and-language navigation increasingly relies on general-purpose semantic planners, yet translating correct high-level intent into reliable physical execution remains difficult in spatially constrained transitions. Reaching a staircase, doorway, or narrow passage does not ensure traversal; the agent must identify an executable affordance pose and recover from accumulated action errors. We propose PACE (Preference-refined Affordance-Conditioned Execution), a supervised local execution module that augments frozen zero-shot semantic planners for reliable cross-floor navigation. PACE grounds transition-related semantics into a long-horizon, agent-centric traversable affordance pose and conditions short-horizon action generation on this spatial target, thereby aligning semantic goals with physical execution. translated_title: 基于可供性条件的决策制定：弥合零样本跨楼层视觉语言导航中的语义-空间鸿沟
translated_abstract: 视觉语言导航越来越依赖于通用语义规划器，但在空间受限的过渡场景中，将正确的高层意图转化为可靠的物理执行仍然很困难。到达楼梯、门口或狭窄通道并不意味着能够完成通行；智能体必须识别一个可执行的可供性姿态，并从累积的动作误差中恢复。我们提出了PACE（偏好优化的可供性条件执行），这是一个监督式局部执行模块，用于增强冻结的零样本语义规划器以实现可靠的跨楼层导航。PACE将与过渡相关的语义锚定为长时程的、以智能体为中心的可通行可供性姿态，并将短时程动作生成条件化于这一空间目标，从而使语义目标与物理执行对齐。我们进一步通过失败感知的偏好优化对PACE进行后训练，利用从执行轨迹中提取的对比正常与失败行为的成对数据（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 提出PACE监督式局部执行模块，通过将语义目标锚定为可执行的可供性姿态并进行失败感知的偏好优化，弥合了零样本跨楼层视觉语言导航中高层语义意图与可靠物理执行之间的鸿沟。
en_tdlr: PACE, a supervised affordance-conditioned local execution module enhanced by failure-aware preference refinement, bridges the semantic-spatial gap between high-level intent and reliable physical execution in zero-shot cross-floor vision-and-language navigation.
